description: This file is a script written in JavaScript with TypeScript type checking, intended to analyze source files for architecture smells in a codebase. It scans TypeScript files for specific patterns indicating architectural issues, such as improper module references and misuse of runtime patterns, and reports these issues.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two entries to determine their order based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Pushes an entry object into the entries array.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Analyzes source files for plugin SDK extension facade re-export patterns that may indicate architecture smells.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Detects direct references to runtime implementation shim files within certain TypeScript source files.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Inspects source files for improper use of runtime service locator patterns, such as global state and accessor functions.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Asynchronously collects architecture smell entries across the project's TypeScript source files.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Converts the collected inventory of architecture smells into a human-readable string format.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Runs the architecture smell check, outputs results in JSON or human-readable format, and returns an exit code.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main entry point that invokes the smell check.
